description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer. It defines the structure, styles, and client-side logic for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data in tabular format.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
